youtube.text:
Kedovo is the AI study companion for CBSE Classes 6 to 12. This is our launch film.

11:47 PM. Exam tomorrow. Still stuck? Not anymore.

Everything for your chapter in one place: notes, NCERT solutions, flashcards, MCQs, case studies and practice questions, 100% NCERT aligned.

Stuck on a doubt? Just ask Kedo, the AI companion that knows your chapter. Or call Kedo and ask out loud in Hindi, English or both. Read your notes in your own language. And meet Kedo, the study buddy who cheers you on.

Learning made finally clear. Get started for free: https://kedovo.com
